mapper.select: SELECT * FROM material_zip_imports WHERE import_id = #{importId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE material_zip_imports SET status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIAL','FAILED','CANCELLED','EXPIRED') THEN NOW() ELSE finished_at END WHERE import_id = #{importId}
UPDATE material_zip_imports SET storage_path = NULL WHERE import_id = #{importId}
mapper.select: SELECT i.* FROM material_zip_imports i WHERE i.status = 'IMPORTING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM material_zip_import_entries e WHERE e.import_id = i.import_id AND e.status IN ('QUEUED', 'IMPORTING')) ORDER BY i.import_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
